record.question: Choose the correct answer from the followings in connection with Uniform Flow in an open channels:
options: Flow properties such as the depth or discharge at a section do not change with time.
Flow properties such as the depth or discharge remain constant along the length of the channel.
Uniform flow practically, can either be steady or un-steady.
Flow in a given channel geometry with only one degree of freedom will always be uniform flow.
